description: This file defines types, interfaces, and constants for the openclaw plugin infrastructure, including plugin configuration, authentication, model resolution, provider hooks, commands, and various plugin capabilities such as speech, transcription, web search, and media generation.

classes.name: PluginLogger
classes.description: Logger interface with optional debug method and mandatory info, warn, and error methods.

classes.name: PluginConfigUiHint
classes.description: Config UI hints such as label, help, tags, advanced, sensitive, placeholder.

classes.name: PluginKind
classes.description: String union type representing plugin kinds ('memory' or 'context-engine').

classes.name: PluginConfigValidation
classes.description: Union type representing validation success or failure with errors.

classes.name: OpenClawPluginConfigSchema
classes.description: Schema contract for plugin configuration, with optional validators and UI hints.

classes.name: OpenClawPluginToolContext
classes.description: Trusted execution context passed to plugin tool factories.

classes.name: OpenClawPluginToolFactory
classes.description: Type for a factory function returning agent tools based on context.

classes.name: OpenClawPluginToolOptions
classes.description: Options for plugin tool registration including name and optionality.

classes.name: OpenClawPluginHookOptions
classes.description: Options for registering plugin hooks, including entry, name, description, and registration flag.

classes.name: ProviderAuthKind
classes.description: String union indicating provider auth types ('oauth', 'api_key', 'token', etc.).

classes.name: ProviderAuthResult
classes.description: Result payload of provider authentication, including profiles, config patch, default model, and notes.

classes.name: ProviderAuthContext
classes.description: Context object for provider login/setup flows.

classes.name: ProviderNonInteractiveApiKeyResult
classes.description: Result object for non-interactive API key resolution, including key, source, and envVarName.

classes.name: ProviderResolveNonInteractiveApiKeyParams
classes.description: Parameters for resolving a non-interactive API key, including provider, flag, env, and allowProfile options.

classes.name: ProviderNonInteractiveApiKeyCredentialParams
classes.description: Credential parameters after resolution, including provider, resolution result, email, and metadata.

classes.name: ProviderAuthMethodNonInteractiveContext
classes.description: Context for non-interactive provider auth methods.

classes.name: ProviderAuthMethod
classes.description: Definition of a provider authentication method, including id, label, hint, kind, wizard, and run protocols.

classes.name: ProviderCatalogOrder
classes.description: String union specifying catalog order preference ('simple', 'profile', 'paired', 'late').

classes.name: ProviderCatalogContext
classes.description: Context object providing config, environment, and provider API key resolution functions.

classes.name: ProviderCatalogResult
classes.description: Union type for provider catalog output, either a single config, multiple configs, or undefined.

classes.name: ProviderPluginCatalog
classes.description: Object with optional order and run function for plugin catalog.

classes.name: ProviderRuntimeModel
classes.description: Runtime model shape including API type and optional tokens count.

classes.name: ProviderRuntimeProviderConfig
classes.description: Configuration object for provider runtime including URL, API, and models.

classes.name: ProviderResolveDynamicModelContext
classes.description: Context for dynamic model resolution, including model registry and config.

classes.name: ProviderPrepareDynamicModelContext
classes.description: Optional async context for prefetching dynamic models.

classes.name: ProviderNormalizeResolvedModelContext
classes.description: Context for normalizing a resolved model before use.

classes.name: ProviderNormalizeModelIdContext
classes.description: Context for normalizing model IDs.

classes.name: ProviderNormalizeConfigContext
classes.description: Context for normalizing provider config entries.

classes.name: ProviderNormalizeTransportContext
classes.description: Context for normalizing transport configuration, such as URLs.

classes.name: ProviderResolveConfigApiKeyContext
classes.description: Context for resolving provider-specific API keys from environment.

classes.name: ProviderPrepareRuntimeAuthContext
classes.description: Context for preparing runtime authentication, including profile ID.

classes.name: ProviderPreparedRuntimeAuth
classes.description: Result object for runtime auth preparation, with API key, URL, expiry, and request override.

classes.name: ProviderResolveUsageAuthContext
classes.description: Context for resolving usage or billing auth tokens, including methods for API key and OAuth token resolution.

classes.name: ProviderResolvedUsageAuth
classes.description: Token and optional account ID for usage auth.

classes.name: ProviderFetchUsageSnapshotContext
classes.description: Context for fetching usage snapshot, including token, accountId, timeout, and fetch function.

classes.name: ProviderAuthDoctorHintContext
classes.description: Context for provider-specific auth doctor hints.

classes.name: ProviderPrepareExtraParamsContext
classes.description: Context for normalizing extra parameters for provider requests.

classes.name: ProviderReplaySanitizeMode
classes.description: String union for replay sanitize modes ('full', 'images-only').

classes.name: ProviderReplayToolCallIdMode
classes.description: String union for tool call ID modes ('strict', 'strict9').

classes.name: ProviderReasoningOutputMode
classes.description: String union for reasoning output modes ('native', 'tagged').

classes.name: ProviderCapabilities
classes.description: Legacy static capability bag, kept for compatibility.

classes.name: ProviderReplayPolicy
classes.description: Replay/transition policies including sanitize modes, signature retention, and validation flags.

classes.name: ProviderReplayPolicyContext
classes.description: Context for replay/transition policies, including model, provider, config, env.

classes.name: ProviderReplaySessionEntry
classes.description: Custom session entries used in replay state.

classes.name: ProviderReplaySessionState
classes.description: Interface for managing replay session entries.

classes.name: ProviderSanitizeReplayHistoryContext
classes.description: Context for replay history sanitization, including messages, session ID, allowed tools, session state.

classes.name: ProviderValidateReplayTurnsContext
classes.description: Context for validating replay turns, including message array and session state.

classes.name: ProviderNormalizeToolSchemasContext
classes.description: Context for normalizing tool schemas before registration.

classes.name: ProviderToolSchemaDiagnostic
classes.description: Diagnostic info for tool schema violations.

classes.name: ProviderReasoningOutputModeContext
classes.description: Context for reasoning output mode preferences.

classes.name: ProviderCreateStreamFnContext
classes.description: Context for creating a provider-specific streaming function.

classes.name: ProviderWrapStreamFnContext
classes.description: Context for wrapping stream functions, including model, stream, and provider info.

classes.name: ProviderTransportTurnState
classes.description: Transport-specific state for a turn, including headers and metadata.

classes.name: ProviderResolveTransportTurnStateContext
classes.description: Context for resolving transport turn state, including provider, model, session, attempt.

classes.name: ProviderWebSocketSessionPolicy
classes.description: Policy for WebSocket sessions, including headers and cooldown.

classes.name: ProviderResolveWebSocketSessionPolicyContext
classes.description: Context for WebSocket session policy resolution.

classes.name: ProviderFailoverErrorContext
classes.description: Context for classifying provider-specific transport errors.

classes.name: ProviderApplyConfigDefaultsContext
classes.description: Context for applying default configs based on provider, environment, and config.

classes.name: PluginEmbeddingProvider
classes.description: Shape of embedded provider for vectorization, embed functions, and client info.

classes.name: ProviderCreateEmbeddingProviderContext
classes.description: Context for creating provider-specific embedding providers.

classes.name: ProviderCacheTtlEligibilityContext
classes.description: Context to determine if cache TTL is eligible for specific provider/model.

classes.name: ProviderBuildMissingAuthMessageContext
classes.description: Context for generating custom missing auth messages.

classes.name: ProviderBuildUnknownModelHintContext
classes.description: Context for generating hint messages for unknown models.

classes.name: ProviderBuiltInModelSuppressionContext
classes.description: Context for suppressing or modifying built-in models.

classes.name: ProviderBuiltInModelSuppressionResult
classes.description: Result object indicating whether to suppress a model and optional error message.

classes.name: ProviderThinkingPolicyContext
classes.description: Context for provider-specific thinking policies.

classes.name: ProviderDefaultThinkingPolicyContext
classes.description: Context for default thinking policies with reasoning info.

classes.name: ProviderModernModelPolicyContext
classes.description: Context for live profile/model filtering based on provider criteria.

classes.name: ProviderAugmentModelCatalogContext
classes.description: Context for augmenting the model catalog with additional entries.

classes.name: ProviderDiscoveryOrder
classes.description: Deprecated: same as ProviderCatalogOrder.

classes.name: ProviderDiscoveryContext
classes.description: Deprecated: same as ProviderCatalogContext.

classes.name: ProviderDiscoveryResult
classes.description: Deprecated: same as ProviderCatalogResult.

classes.name: ProviderPluginDiscovery
classes.description: Deprecated: same as ProviderPluginCatalog.

classes.name: WebSearchProviderId

classes.name: WebFetchProviderId
classes.description: Type for web fetch provider identifiers.

classes.name: WebSearchProviderToolDefinition
classes.description: Definition for a web search tool, including description, parameters, and execute function.

classes.name: WebFetchProviderToolDefinition
classes.description: Definition for a web fetch tool, including description, parameters, and execute function.

classes.name: WebSearchProviderContext
classes.description: Context for a search provider including configuration and runtime metadata.

classes.name: WebFetchProviderContext
classes.description: Context for a fetch provider including configuration and fetch metadata.

classes.name: WebSearchCredentialResolutionSource

classes.name: WebSearchRuntimeMetadataContext
classes.description: Context for resolving web search runtime metadata including credentials.

classes.name: WebSearchProviderSetupContext
classes.description: Setup context for web search providers with config, runtime, prompter, defaults.

classes.name: WebFetchCredentialResolutionSource
classes.description: 'config' | 'secretRef' | 'env' | 'missing'

classes.name: WebFetchRuntimeMetadataContext
classes.description: Context for resolving web fetch runtime metadata, including credentials.

classes.name: WebSearchProviderPlugin
classes.description: Definition for a search provider plugin.

classes.name: PluginWebSearchProviderEntry
classes.description: Web search provider plugin entry with pluginId.

classes.name: WebFetchProviderPlugin
classes.description: Definition for a fetch provider plugin.

classes.name: PluginWebFetchProviderEntry
classes.description: Web fetch provider plugin entry with pluginId.

classes.name: SpeechProviderPlugin
classes.description: Definition for a speech provider plugin.

classes.name: PluginSpeechProviderEntry
classes.description: Speech provider plugin entry with pluginId.

classes.name: RealtimeTranscriptionProviderPlugin
classes.description: Definition for a real-time transcription provider plugin.

classes.name: PluginRealtimeTranscriptionProviderEntry
classes.description: Realtime transcription provider entry with pluginId.

classes.name: RealtimeVoiceProviderPlugin
classes.description: Definition for a real-time voice provider plugin.

classes.name: PluginRealtimeVoiceProviderEntry
classes.description: Realtime voice provider entry with pluginId.

classes.name: MediaUnderstandingProviderPlugin
classes.description: Type alias for media understanding provider plugin.

classes.name: ImageGenerationProviderPlugin
classes.description: Type alias for image generation provider plugin.

classes.name: VideoGenerationProviderPlugin
classes.description: Type alias for video generation provider plugin.

classes.name: OpenClawPluginGatewayMethod
classes.description: Definition for a gateway method with method name and handler.

classes.name: PluginCommandContext
classes.description: Context for handling plugin commands, including sender ID, channel info, args, command, config, and session data.

classes.name: PluginConversationBindingRequestParams
classes.description: Params for requesting or managing conversation bindings.

classes.name: PluginConversationBindingResolutionDecision
classes.description: 'allow-once' | 'allow-always' | 'deny'

classes.name: PluginConversationBinding
classes.description: Data shape for a conversation binding with plugin and channel info.

classes.name: PluginConversationBindingRequestResult
classes.description: Union type for binding request response statuses.

classes.name: PluginConversationBindingResolvedEvent
classes.description: Event indicating conversation binding approval/denial with request and decision.

classes.name: PluginCommandResult
classes.description: Type for the output of plugin command handlers.

classes.name: PluginCommandHandler
classes.description: Function type for handling plugin commands.

classes.name: OpenClawPluginCommandDefinition
classes.description: Descriptor for defining a plugin command including name, aliases, description, and handler.

classes.name: PluginInteractiveHandlerResult
classes.description: Optional result indicating whether an interactive command was handled.

classes.name: BivariantInteractiveHandler
classes.description: Hack for covariant/bivariant typing for interactive handlers.

classes.name: PluginInteractiveRegistration
classes.description: Registration shape for interactive handlers including channel, namespace, and handler.

classes.name: PluginInteractiveHandlerRegistration
classes.description: Alias for interactive handler registration.

classes.name: OpenClawPluginHttpRouteAuth
classes.description: 'gateway' | 'plugin'

classes.name: OpenClawPluginHttpRouteMatch
classes.description: 'exact' | 'prefix'

classes.name: OpenClawPluginHttpRouteHandler
classes.description: Function type for route handler receiving request and response.

classes.name: OpenClawPluginHttpRouteParams
classes.description: Parameters for defining an HTTP route, including path, handler, auth, match, and replacement flag.

classes.name: OpenClawPluginCliContext
classes.description: CLI context passed to plugin CLI registrar, containing program, config, workspace, and logger.

classes.name: OpenClawPluginCliRegistrar
classes.description: Function type for registering CLI commands in plugin.

classes.name: OpenClawPluginCliCommandDescriptor
classes.description: Descriptor for a CLI command: name, description, subcommand flag.

classes.name: OpenClawPluginServiceContext
classes.description: Context for plugin service lifecycle, including config, workspace, state, and logger.

classes.name: OpenClawPluginService
classes.description: Background service object with start and optional stop methods.

classes.name: CliBackendPlugin
classes.description: Definition for a backend plugin, including ID, config, optional MCP bundle flag and config normalizer.

classes.name: OpenClawPluginChannelRegistration
classes.description: Registration object for plugin channels, referencing plugin's channel plugin.

classes.name: OpenClawPluginDefinition
classes.description: Top-level plugin definition loaded from native plugin files, including ID, name, description, version, kind, schema, registration, activation.

ctags.name: AssertAllPluginHookNamesListed
ctags.pattern: /^type AssertAllPluginHookNamesListed = MissingPluginHookNames extends never ? true : never;$/
